stories.name: Evan turns a client brief into an Epic-Feature-Story map in one sitting
Surface count + kit-coverage estimate within an hour of signing, to quote honestly
A non-technical client can read and correct the story map (HTML)
Stories carry EARS-style acceptance criteria gates can check
brief.md surface table feeds the designer; every registry surface traces to a story
Registry seeded from the brief without rewriting
Given the story map, the moodboard orchestrator fans out per-epic reference-gathering prompts and curates real apps to steal from
Each reference's key screens are captured (probe-runner) and saved with semantic filenames (ref__screen.png)
The moodboard assembles as a browsable doc linking references and shots to the epics they inform; every embedded shot verified on disk
The design stage receives the moodboard alongside the brief and consults it before authoring
Brief to clickable htmx prototype in under 10 minutes, carrying structure not pixels
Every surface designed at 390/744/1280 from targets alone (literal parity)
Target selection labels buildability on this machine (requires macOS)
Select a screen, chat exclusively in its context; all other screens dim
Selection is a removable context chip: this surfaceId's spec, never the whole app
Hard tool-gating: only this screen's tools exposed (edit-layout, restyle, adjust-states, regenerate)
Text/token tweaks apply instantly, no model round-trip
Each message checkpoints this screen only; one-tap revert, rendered before/after
Stale-selection guard: prototype changed since selection triggers re-sync or warn
Shared token/nav edit offers 'affects N screens, apply to all?' (nobody ships this)
Hash-locked freeze; approval bound to the design hash; post-approval change goes stale loudly
Drift report + brief-to-surface-to-code traceability
Start a build, walk away; stops on red, ESC_LIMIT=3
Per-surface evidence report (screen to tests to code), not one giant diff
SARIF findings pinned to file/line with reproduce command
Three gates an agent can reach but never pass; approval = human + any authenticated shell, provenance-bound (shell, device/node identity, confirm method, timestamp, hash)
Approve/reject from phone push with biometric confirm
Pre-submission checklist gate (crashes/permissions, where generated apps die)
probe-runner design-vs-built gates: pixel (SSIM), skeleton, colour (deltaE) against the frozen golden
Smoke per target: app boots, first screen renders, no crash
app-box auto-captures screenshots of design + built app per surface (probe-runner)
Flows on a canvas: living captures, connections truth-derived from real navigation
Replayable named flows for gate reviews; zoom-semantic canvas keyed to story-map sections
Per-platform builds from one codebase; unbuildable targets hard-block as a named precondition, never a red gate
Payment gate at first deploy: licence required to ship; everything before it free
Export-always: ordinary Stacked MVVM in my own repo, no export tier
Guided store submission (most-cited unmet gap in every builder)
One-scan QR pairing (host/port/nonce/key fingerprint); relayed QR fails the pin
Device list with last-seen + revoke; revoke drops the session immediately
LAN-only by default, no cloud relay; an agent can never mint an approval
Push when a gate goes red (deduped per transition), deep-link into the gate card
Actionable notification: approve/reject without opening the app
Self-host tailnet (compose file) or hosted Tailscale; pre-auth key in the QR; approvals bind to WireGuard node identity
Private mesh CA gives trusted HTTPS origins over the mesh (arxa ADR-0036 pattern)
Showcase app launches on install, automatically; quality visible in minute one
First project to working prototype in 20 minutes or less, no docs (timed; over 20 is a finding)
Stubs labelled before you build against them; kit availability honest
Credential tier stated on screen (stored in the macOS Keychain)
Empty states carry wording, not blank surfaces
Multi-project management; registry CRUD; add/delete feature yields byte-identical round-trip
BYO key in OS vault, never logged; no inference metering, cost is yours and visible
Flat licence, never per-seat; pay at first deploy
Kit vendoring from targets + capabilities; dependencyMode config from day one
A visitor gets app-box in 30 seconds: gated pipeline, own-your-code export, pay-at-deploy
The three human gates are the headline, shown not told (recorded gate flow)
Pricing page: flat licence, never per-seat, BYO key, pay at first deploy (the anti-credit-rage page)
Docs portal publishes the knowledge base (architecture, plans, research, skills) with search
Getting-started mirrors Michelle's 20 minutes: install, showcase, first prototype
Public honesty page: what is wired, what throws, what is roadmap
Recorded walkthroughs and design-vs-built comparisons (probe-runner captures) prove quality before install
Demo videos per persona journey (Evan's modes, Michelle's 20 minutes)
Download per platform: macOS dmg, daemon CLI for Windows/Linux, mobile apps, with the honest build matrix
Licence purchase and activation, pay-at-deploy explained before checkout
Changelog and release notes per version
